review.note: Retracted in M40b: the famine of 1932–33 in Soviet Ukraine, part of the wider Soviet famine of 1930–33 and now recognised by many states as a genocide. Its causes are collectivisation, the grain procurement quotas and the closing of the republic's borders, and the atlas holds no record of any of them; its consequences here would be a question of memory and recognition, decades later, which this atlas has no records for either. Wiring it to the civil war or to October would be an invention.

title: Holodomor
summary: Wikidata item Q165058, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "man-made famine in Soviet Ukraine in 1932–33 that killed as many as seven million Ukrainians". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
